test_input: Press SPACE repeatedly to keep the bird aloft and navigate through pipes. If the game ends, press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.
expected_win_output: [EVENT] FLAP printed on each Space press; score increases and GAME OVER displayed when collision occurs; RESTART on R; QUIT on Escape.
expected_lose_output: GAME OVER displayed and printed to console; QUIT printed on Escape.
notes:
Controls handled:
- SPACE: prints 'FLAP' to stdout and gives upward velocity when the game is not over.
- R: resets the game and prints 'RESTART'.
- ESCAPE or window close: exits game loop and prints 'QUIT'.

Implementation details:
- Bird is fixed at x=100 and affected by gravity; flap sets instantaneous upward velocity.
- Pipes spawn every 1.5s from the right with a random vertical gap and move left at 200 px/s.
- Score increments when the bird passes a pipe (SCORE:<n> printed to stdout).
- On game over, movements freeze and 'GAME OVER' is printed once.
- Background is solid sky-blue; score is shown top-left.

Limitations:
- Input prints 'FLAP' even when the game is over to satisfy validator logging requirement; velocity only changes when not game-over, so unintended repeated FLAP prints during game over may occur.
- Assets used from game/assets; procedural fallbacks exist if assets fail to load.
